text: SPMD small R Package implementing Symmetric Pair Matching Design (SPMD). Briefly, SPMD self-controlled method allows estimation causal effect possible re-current binary exposure possible re-current event. similar spirit famous self-controlled case series (SCCS) design sense bi-directional, using time exposures controls (irrespective events). However, unlike SCCS method, automatically adjusts time-invariant confounders, also automatically adjusts time-effects, without requiring assumptions functional form time effects. creating pairs individuals, individual acts control individual respective exposure time. can shown mild assumptions multiplicative effects interactions, individual-level effects time effects cancel perfectly. details, please consult associated paper (Denz et al. 2026).
